  • ETH communication utilizing the second layer of the OSI model
  • CyberSecurity


Qualifications

  • C and C++ for embedded SW
  • Processor peripherals
  • Communication buses (UART, SPI, I2C…)
  • ETH communication layers
  • Real-time OS
  • Thread-safe programming

The selection process consists of two interviews. The first interview is technical and takes place in person. The second interview is usually online.


About the Research & Development Department

ComAp has its headquarters in Prague. R&D department covers software and hardware development, certification, and sourcing teams. We develop our own products (control systems for energy infrastructure), currently for segments including hybrid microgrids, marine, gensets, etc. We emphasize quality throughout the entire development process.

We are building internal AI skills and actively support our people in developing them. As a company, we are learning to use them as effectively, safely, and ethically as possible. The developer remains the author of the code — AI helps them work faster, not in their place. Our developers handle architecture, quality, and business logic; AI serves as a tool, not an author.

ComAp specializes in smart power control solutions and services designed for the independent and backup power generation markets.
